notes.title: Your Build Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/b43cf2348ef7a99e79cbe78dc21237bbf209ff41.png[/img]

This fresh update from Teak brings total freedom in six new ways to play this Beat' em up!

Let's start with the new Stats that will make the difference in every combat.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/926f905a93b97382ff138692f3ab9dce28588dee.png[/img]

[u][b]PHYSICAL DAMAGE[/b][/u]

The physical damage is made from our main attacks "Kally's Scyche and Eerik Punches".

Using charged attacks will duplicate our damage by 200%

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/a60e842fa27a6805560f07c288a243bc051629df.png[/img]

[u][b]MAGICAL DAMAGE[/b][/u]

The magical damage "or AP" will be useful for distance attacks shooting spells that cause damage in ranged situations. By the way, each spell we shoot will take part from our soul power.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/8e5559ee41bc5e044a8ac7691eb493634c460f8a.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/791bb7c879eaf3a2cb3561488d394faf990d56ed.png[/img]

[u][b]SPECIAL DAMAGE[/b][/u]

Special Damage is basically our damage caused by definitive special attacks.
The more SP the more One-Shots you can cause to strong enemies.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/88c5ddd3c08b53f627274ec1e886ffe7d570b3ea.png[/img]

[u][b]DEFENSE[/b][/u]

A new stat for the game that indeed, it is useful as hell for the players who just can't survive their current run. 

Our characters have a % of defense, if we have enough percentage of Defense there could be possibilities of block an attack or explosion.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/ffa6286381fed15dba6ce14eade4663899822673.gif[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/9accaf7b1054e4014abb0a059e81ae47046856e5.png[/img]

[u][b]ATTACK SPEED[/b][/u]

Now we are talking! You want to throw punches like a tornado or just kick slowly but surely?  The choose is yours.

For Example: 10% is just like a zombie... sooo slow, but 100% is insta-Attack.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/e1def7b338c280dc982b7a72ce240069dca4ccc3.png[/img]

[u][b]MOVEMENT[/b][/u]

In Teak, at any combat you need a handicap, this one will be above all the movement speed, the more speed you have, the more faster you will be for your enemies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/88ddbc2f7e5d130c82b8f55a8ee5ac6ff238e0df.png[/img]


With this 6 new stats in the game, you can make sure to play as you want, you can be a juggernaut that just blocks enemy attacks, a blue hedgehog that punches so hard, or just chill and kill anything in one touch "you need lot's of money for this"

Anyway! This tomorrow the game should be released for everyone.

Have tons of fun! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: 1.4.5 Cool Changes
notes.notes:
Hi again guys! Here's the changes of The Eerie Adventures Of Kally 1.4.5 update.

This version brings new important changes to gameplay and introduces new mechanics for the game.


SOULS 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/a841e377f4446ea7b24cea15d3b8419f647c6652.gif[/img]

¿Do you know that you have powers, and for use them you should collect souls?  

That's it, now at Teak you should recollect enemies souls to use your attacks and power strikes, if you are out of Souls, you can always use weapons as the main pickaxe "less damage" or drop objects.


SUPERNATURAL TRANSFORMATIONS

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/c767d98990198a837eb71f7afe94a4f3908baab8.gif[/img]

This is LeeGod Eerik, the soul version of Eerik, when you reach a big number of souls you can use them to transform yourself into an upgraded character.

Kally  =  Grim Reaper

Eerik =  Lee God Eerik


HEALTH FOR MONSTERS

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/0df61a59bfc62e0583c5d668f764f5a0b2d46819.gif[/img]

In the old versions of Teak, we are without data about how long could a monster stay alive with our attacks, is time to change that and see this important information.

SOUL METER

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/25b73d5959dd779e07e18954158847b745765cf7.gif[/img]

This is our meter by colors, when is more bright more souls we have, if is clear there's no souls in our character.


MAJOR BUG FIXES

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/40e1550786c5280ec1dd76b578ff5f7895a1fba3.gif[/img]

Things like "Black Borders", breakable controls and other stuff are polished to have a better experience and a better control in enemies waves to make sure nobody lose the progress anymore.


REMOVED LIVES

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/46d729259e619889781274f6309ed10b5189960c.png[/img]

In Teak i removed the Lives mechanic because i felt it unnecessary in the game, the idea is to take care of our health points and eat food and potions to stay alive in the castle.

NEW ENEMIES


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/9efab60373fc14cc86f30f2eb741bdebf469e2a9.gif[/img]

Holy hell! New ghosts and beasts!


WEAPON DAMAGE LIST


-Pickaxe "4 DMG"

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/0aa237dd6a3f957fd2aabc81b83b393fe37fee30.png[/img]


-Main Attacks  "CURRENT PLAYER DMG IN STATS"

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/78af92c50d5c332f43f1950d3f9d6233117e2dad.png[/img]

-Gun  "12 DMG"

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/50ae3fa38ca1288779fcc9a62d81d5ffb2e49cdf.png[/img]

-Shotgun  "32 DMG"

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/2623e54ef527c41955a9bb91a2fb8555ac2243be.png[/img]

-Shuriken "37 DMG"

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/8382ff9c0b5be6f79a112e94fb2d8128ea7566b9.png[/img]

-Nuclear Launcher  "INSTAKILL THE ZONE"

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/826a41d93bcbc194189835d6c31b36c5dd0126e6.png[/img]


BOOGIEMAN'S RULES


To make the experience more challenging, now if you are unlucky.. BoogieMan will use game rules in order to ruin us as players.

If you lose a rule.. The punisher punishes the player chasing him in the current level, if the player get's touch by the Punisher this will die instantly.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/f22beea60a693d82d829be57facf50969eb26155.png[/img]

---------------THE RULES--------------------

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/aa597111633032fa5eb5c4b0f0963a3c911dd979.png[/img]

DON'T TOUCH 

As the title says, if we got hit by a monster or something, we lose the rule.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/2304f334716aeaf725b2b5fd1ccaedb643ff26b0.png[/img]

OBJECT LOVER

At this rule, if we break any object from the castle, we lose the rule.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/3164dfbabd4441eda8e857d5e929e07eaca6aa57.png[/img]

PACIFIC WARRIOR

You can't deal melee attacks or specials, but you can use Weapons and Drop objects.



SPOOKY WALKING SIMULATOR

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/44e414f6f3d9916b90c6f538141b6da56dbedcfe.png[/img]


At some points of the game, we will walk in little hallways or areas in First Person View "FPS",  we should have careful to not get jumpscared or we will die by a Heart Attack.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/3a83922ef3a9c487d4338413237e15532f329f56.png[/img]


DEFEAT THE BOSS FIGHTS AGAIN

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/b6559623307aaa23fab6a6f23f5e335cd4974d34.png[/img]

In Teak there's an special room  "Boss Room" , now you can fight the final bosses you have defeated before.



AND A LOT MORE OF STUFF !


LAST WORDS FROM DS

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/d1b34862282e3d4ee54f2970d114f271c2ed6740.png[/img]

Some people ask me about, why i'm called Infinite Games Studios?
The truth is that since i was a kid i wished to have a big company called like that, so, now everyone who works or helps me, we are infinite games studios.

You, your friend, the composers, the background artist and our dear players.

I knew there was some problems, there may be something to polish in the game.  But i don't stop with Teak until is perfect for everyone.

Setbacks where made in order to surprise everyone with a better gameplay and experience.

A big hug for the players, enjoy my game! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Teak Patch 1.4.4
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/b8143600e67023c4e9dad9e3207b3aba07b90822.png[/img]

Hi people!  Since the release i was working in the game to fix a lot of problems that disturb the player experience, since unespected crashes to soft-locks that doesn't let you continue your game. 

Let's gonna take a look at the changes:



-Changes in the resolution, the last build of the game had "Black bars" problems and this prevent the player to have more vision or worse, the interface is "cuted" so for the moment a solution was found, you should restart the game each time we change the resolution.

-Rooms that softlock or doesn't clear, some areas of the game had this in the last update, a lot of rooms have been fix from this, but i know that there's a few ones that still with this problem, this should be fixed asap for the next fix of the day.

-Animation resets on our characters, on Kally or Eerik, you can reset the animations "Glitch them" by droping objects or get jumpscared "Shocked". This cause a weird sense of insecurity and break the experience.
The current patch have this fixed.

-Unespected buttons that doesn't work, at the last build of the game we could press ACTION to use elements in the levels, but some of them doesn't work well, or even break the element.
The current patch have solved this in some elements, but i still working on it.

- Indicators and Help Icons updated, in the last build sometimes the game doesn't tell us where to go or what to do "In the Lobby room there was no indicators of the things "
So with this patch this would be fixed

- LONG limit of areas,  i think 50 areas is too much for some normal players, unless you are a beast guy that can beat it, so depending from your difficulty you can change it for 50 to 35, you still fighting the final boss.

-Critical Damage, this is a new component in the game, the critical damage is a " % " double damage that you cause to the enemies, to get critical damage you have to talk with "Cheng Fu" a helper teacher that will show us the critical powers.

-Unespected behaviours!!  The monsters of the last build where so basic, just move around and punches if you are around, but now they have surprise reactions, for example, the zombie could fart in the area making hard to reach him,   the skeletons can throw a brutal uppercut, the gargoyles can get angry and throw docens of punchs, etc..


-4 New Throwable objects,  now we have more throwable objects to launch against the horde, a living room table, Wooden stuff, an electronic tesla turret and a nuclear explosive barrel!! Wow.


-General Changes,  this patch changes so much stuff in the game as you readed before, it will be completed today for everyone, for the moment you play the current phase of this patch in the current build.


Good luck guys, in Teak there's a lot of demons and creatures, they ask for souls you collected and money, if we do not complete the task well,  we are so dead..

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/d3a0310bd6f1bf8a17916f564cebfbbe63aa7983.png[/img]

notes.title: The Eerie Adventures Of Kally 1.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Teak had to be released this last 25, but i felt that the game doesn't fit with the quality that everyone wants.

So, this next two weeks i will have it ready.  

For now, i just can show you what we are about to play with this teaser.


Sorry for this delay! But we will have Teak soon!  

_____________________________________________

TEAK 1.0 V


- 3 Special Attacks

- Single player story mode

- New KnockOut mechanic.

- Scary rooms "Walking simulator"

-Voice Acting

notes.title: The Eerie Adventures Of Kally | Scary Beat'em up
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

With The Eerie Adventures of Kally i bring back a video game genre that has been a bit forgotten for some years, known as Beat’Em Up.

Games where the seasoned veterans remember how they fought against strong and tough-looking enemies to get to the next stage and continue our adventure.

Inspired by "Grabbed by the ghoulies" "Dragon's Lair" and "The Grim Adventures of Billy and Mandy"  

In this action/horror rogue-like videogame we will take control of Kally or Eerik, our two young main characters that suddenly find themselves in Hell!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31235729/d96e6bae9958b9e6267e38428bc7676cd1c49167.png[/img]
